evidence.detail: Exact v308 rs/gui/d is a stateless static holder for the RuneLite UI color palette, including (220,138,0), its alpha-120 variant, the dark/darker gray sequence, progress green/red/orange, light green, gold, blue and dark background colors.

Historical RuneLite/OpenOSRS net.runelite.client.ui.ColorScheme preserves the same leading BRAND_ORANGE = new Color(220,138,0), BRAND_ORANGE_TRANSPARENT = new Color(220,138,0,120) and matching shared UI palette role.
The exact class is consumed throughout the recovered RuneLite-derived UI family, including SwingUtil, RuneLiteSkin and launcher/side-panel rendering; it owns no behavior beyond shared UI colors.

proposals.note: Exact source-name recovery for RuneLite/OpenOSRS ColorScheme from the matching static palette and UI-consumer family.
